units.source_text: ……完成了奇迹之后的柏木变得快活起来，快活得快要病了。

en.t: ...After accomplishing the miracle, Kashiwagi became cheerful, so cheerful that he was almost sick with it.

units.source_text: 他纵声大笑，冷不防地把女子抱在膝上，亲吻起来。

en.t: He burst into loud laughter, suddenly pulled the woman onto his lap, and began kissing her.

units.source_text: 他的笑声在洼地里的无计其数的松树梢上旋荡、久久地旋荡。

en.t: His laughter swirled above the countless pine treetops in the hollow, circling there for a long time.
